notes.title: Aphotic has won an award!
notes.content:
[h3]HeroFest 2024[/h3]
I recently had the chance to meet some of you at [url=https://herofest.ch/en]HeroFest in Bern[/url], to discuss and test the game together! This was [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2842190/Aphotic_Demo/]Aphotic[/url]'s first appearance at a public event, and the game was in top shape. Many of you played the demo at the Play Don't Tell booth, and I am happy to say that your feedback was positive. [b]I'd like to thank all the kind messages: they're a great help in keeping the project going![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43462061/41df8258079a23b4837d2139acb08d6a5f532b33.jpg[/img]

[h3]An award for Aphotic[/h3]
For the first time since its creation, HeroFest organized an awards ceremony for the video games presented at the event, and I'm proud to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2842190/Aphotic_Demo/]Aphotic[/url] [url=https://www.linkedin.com/posts/una-micheroli_gamedevelopment-awards-designexcellence-activity-7251918051812462592-8VR1?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop][b]won the Nox award for Excellence in technical achievement[/b][/url]. I'm even prouder that [b]this is the first event Aphotic has participated in[/b], so I'm excited about the future of the game's development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43462061/c1b362edfb8bc15e1c42c484887b156687eabd43.jpg[/img]

[h3]Share your feedback[/h3]
Also, [b]you can now give me feedback on the demo via [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfFyC9MlZ_bcHnOg9PhWUV_jBBLtLYENaDoH2AdLBWBk2ULlA/viewform?usp=sf_link]this quick form[/url][/b]. All your comments are valuable to me and will be carefully taken into account. Thank you to those who have already completed it.

See you soon, and have fun!
